getProfiles.title: GetProfiles
getProfiles.description: Retrieve the profile with the specified token or all defined media profiles. If no Type is provided the returned profiles shall contain no configuration information. If a single Type with value 'All' is provided the returned profiles shall include all associated configurations. Otherwise the requested list of configurations shall for each profile include the configurations present as Type.
